User Stories: As a Registered User, I want to add an item to my cart.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall add the item with quantity 1 and show confirmation (FR-6.1).
Steps to Test:
1. Log in
2. Open an item
3. Click Add to Cart
4. Verify confirmation

User Stories: As a Guest, I want to add an item to a cart.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall block Guests from cart/checkout and prompt registration (FR-1.8, FR-6.1).
Steps to Test:
1. Continue as Guest
2. Open an item
3. Attempt Add to Cart
4. Verify registration prompt

User Stories: As a Registered User, I want to change an item's quantity.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall recalculate subtotal and total (FR-6.3).
Steps to Test:
1. Open Cart
2. Change quantity
3. Verify subtotal and total update

User Stories: As a Registered User, I want to remove items or clear my cart.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall remove individual items or clear all, recalculating totals (FR-6.4).
Steps to Test:
1. Open Cart
2. Remove one item
3. Click Clear Cart
4. Confirm
5. Verify cart emptied

User Stories: As a Registered User, I want my cart to persist across sessions.
Acceptance Criteria: The cart shall persist across logout/login (FR-6.1).
Steps to Test:
1. Add item to cart
2. Logout
3. Login
4. Open Cart and verify item remains

User Stories: As a Registered User, I want to complete a mock checkout.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall process via the mock gateway, create an order record (items, store names, address, timestamp), clear the cart, and show confirmation (FR-6.5, FR-6.6). and display the optional, skippable Fit-Accuracy Rating pop-up (FR-6.6, FR-7.5).
Steps to Test:
1. Open Cart
2. Proceed to Checkout
3. Enter address and payment method
4. Place Order
5. Verify confirmation and order in history                                                                                                                                                                                                                6. Verify the skippable 1–5 star Fit-Accuracy Rating pop-up ("How accurately did the avatar preview show this garment on you?") appears and can be submitted or skipped.

User Stories: As a Registered User, I want to check out. The mock payment was declined.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall show an error, create no order, and keep the cart intact (UC-12/UC-13 ext).
Steps to Test:
1. Proceed to Checkout
2. Trigger a simulated payment decline
3. Verify error and no order created
4. Verify cart intact

User Stories: As a Registered User, I want to view my order history.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall list orders chronologically with Order ID, date, total, status, item count (FR-6.7).
Steps to Test:
1. Log in
2. Open Order History
3. Verify chronological list

Access Type / Pre-Condition: Registered User with a past order
User Stories: As a Registered User, I want to view a specific order's details.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall show full order details including store name per item (FR-6.8).
Steps to Test:
1. Open Order History
2. Click an order
3. Verify full details and store names

Access Type / Pre-Condition: Registered User; item delisted/deleted by Seller
User Stories: As a Registered User, I want to add an item. The item is no longer available.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall show "Item unavailable" and prevent adding (UC-11 ext).
Steps to Test:
1. Delist/delete an item (as Seller)
2. As User, attempt to add that item
3. Verify unavailable message and blocked add

User Stories: As a user, I want the app to feel instant.
Acceptance Criteria: 95% of catalog, filtering, recommendation, and commerce APIs return ≤500 ms (Criterion 1).
Steps to Test:
1. Run automated script against API endpoints.
2. Compute 95th percentile response time.

User Stories: As a user, I want my data encrypted in transit.
Acceptance Criteria: Staging traffic uses TLS 1.2+ via local CA; no plaintext HTTP on demo URL (Criterion 7).
Steps to Test:
1. Open staging URL.
2. Inspect browser security certificate and TLS version.

User Stories: As a user, I want to complete my mock purchase.
Acceptance Criteria: ≥70% of created carts during UAT complete the simulated mock checkout (Criterion 8).
Steps to Test:
1. Track carts created vs checkouts completed during UAT.
2. Calculate completion percentage.

Access Type / Pre-Condition: Staging application available; standard campus Wi-Fi
User Stories: As a user, I want the application to load promptly.
Acceptance Criteria: The initial application load shall complete in under 3 seconds under the agreed test conditions (SRS §4.1; Scope Criterion 3).
Steps to Test:
1. Open the staging application using the agreed browser and campus Wi-Fi.
2. Measure the initial load time using the agreed measurement method.
3. Repeat the agreed number of runs.
4. Record each result and whether the target was met.

Features: UAT: Purchase Confidence and Return Intent
Access Type / Pre-Condition: UAT participant; in-app pre/post confidence and return-intent prompts active
User Stories: As a shopper, I want to evaluate how a try-on affects my purchase confidence and return intent.
Acceptance Criteria: Mock checkout completes, order record is accurate, and optional in-app pre/post confidence/return-intent prompts + Fit-Accuracy pop-up capture responses in-app during UAT; ≥80% population-level KPI is deferred to post-deployment (Criterion 11, Scope v1.1).
Steps to Test:
1. Complete the optional in-app pre-session confidence and return-intent prompts (1–5 scale).
2. Complete the virtual try-on and recommendation walkthrough on the avatar.
3. Complete the optional in-app post-session confidence and return-intent prompts (1–5 scale).
4. Complete mock checkout and verify the optional, skippable 1–5 star Fit-Accuracy Rating pop-up appears.
5. Verify responses save in-app for Registered Users (and panel observes functional completion; ≥80% population KPI deferred post-deployment).
